answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the minimum stake plus attestation effort, making mass forgery expensive. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a staked identity registry: each agent must lock a bond before earning reputation, and peers attest only to work backed by that bond. Like a canyon that narrows to one path, entry is constrained; reputation acts as a mirror reflecting real history; and honest agents tend the garden of shared trust, pruning duplicates through slashing. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
